replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body:
There seems to be a lot of discussion about the arcade so I'll clear some thing up.

The arcade is *not* expected to be released on the nise update. We have too much on our plate and haven't solidified how it should work. We want unique ideas to make the arcade really special, so I'd say it is best to contribute it that way for now. Maps are good but we don't exactly know what games will exist in the full release.
